description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5305014750553 SCREW,CAP,SOCKET HE: Line 0001 Qty 172 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0042 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
